description: R1: JWT authentication - explicitly implemented and validated

requirement.text: The system must implement JWT-based user authentication with token refresh.

implementation.text: auth_middleware.py implements JWT token validation, generation, and refresh logic. Fully implements Requirement R1.

evaluation.text: The authentication module is well-implemented. JWT tokens are correctly validated and refresh logic is present. Score: 9/10.

description: R2: GNN training - implemented but with negative evaluation

requirement.text: The system must implement a GNN training pipeline for anomaly detection supporting both supervised and unsupervised modes.

implementation.text: train_gnn.py implements the GNN training loop. Implements R2-gnn-training.

evaluation.text: The GNN implementation is incomplete. Unsupervised mode is absent and the training loop lacks early stopping. Score: 4/10.

description: R3: REST API - implemented without evaluation

requirement.text: The system must expose a REST API with endpoints for model inference.

implementation.text: api/routes.py implements the REST API endpoints for model inference. References R3-rest-api.
